opsec_notes: This scan generates a lot of DNS queries, which can be detected by network monitoring tools.
CrowdStrike Falcon detects Nmap scans based on process tree anomalies and command-line entropy scoring.
Sysmon EID 25 logs Nmap activity, making it easy to identify in security event logs.
Defender for Endpoint can detect Nmap scans through AMSI logs and parent-child process relationships.

Network congestion can make some ports appear open but unresponsive.
Firewall rules or access controls can prevent Nmap from detecting certain services.
